1.t: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another

3.t: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;

4.t: By those who winnow with a winnowing,

5.t: By those who bring down the Reminder,

7.t: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.

8.t: So when the stars are put out,

9.t: And when the sky is riven asunder,

10.t: And when the mountains are blown away,

11.t: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -

12.t: For what day is the time appointed?

14.t: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -

15.t: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

16.t: Destroyed We not the former folk,

17.t: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?

18.t: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.

19.t: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

20.t: Did We not create you from a base fluid

21.t: Which We laid up in a safe abode

23.t: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!

24.t: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

25.t: Have We not made the earth a receptacle

26.t: Both for the living and the dead,

27.t: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?

28.t: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

29.t: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;

30.t: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,

31.t: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.

32.t: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,

33.t: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.

34.t: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

35.t: This is a day wherein they speak not,

36.t: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.

37.t: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

38.t: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.

39.t: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.

40.t: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

41.t: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,

42.t: And fruits such as they desire.

43.t: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.

44.t: Thus do We reward the good.

45.t: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

46.t: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.

47.t: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

48.t: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!

49.t: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!

50.t: In what statement, after this, will they believe?
